ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_WealthManagementGroupList_DID
AS
BEGIN


WITH TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList AS
(
	SELECT
		BDW.RM AS RM
		,BDW.CLUSTER AS ClusterName
		,BDW.account_number AS CustomerAccountId
		,BDW.fcbs_customer_id AS CustomerId
		,'WMG' AS BusinessUnit
		,BDW.INSERT_DTTM AS PeriodStartDate
		,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
		,BDW.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DID' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDW.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		--,'INSERT' AS RECORD_STATUS
		FROM BUSC.DID_WMGLIST BDW 
		WHERE BDW.ISLATEST = '1'
		AND BDW.account_number IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList FROM TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			RM
			,ClusterName
			,CustomerAccountId
			,CustomerId
			,BusinessUnit
			--,PeriodStartDate
			--,PeriodEndDate
			,FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
			,CustomerAccountId, CustomerId --,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList --WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			RM
			,ClusterName
			,CustomerAccountId
			,CustomerId
			,BusinessUnit
			--,PeriodStartDate
			--,PeriodEndDate
			,FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
			,CustomerAccountId, CustomerId
	FROM BNKM.WealthManagementGroupList WHERE PeriodEndDate in ('9999-12-31')
),

TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
		,CASE
			WHEN TGT.CustomerAccountId IS NULL AND TGT.CustomerId IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
			ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_TGT TGT
	 ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
	 AND SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
--SELECT COUNT(*) CNT, RECORD_STATUS FROM TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_DELTA
--WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT','UPDATE')
--GROUP BY RECORD_STATUS;

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = dateadd(dd,-1,getDate()) 
FROM BNKM.WealthManagementGroupList TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate in ('9999-12-31')


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.WealthManagementGroupList ( 
RM
,ClusterName
,CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,BusinessUnit
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	 SRC.RM AS RM
	,SRC.ClusterName AS ClusterName
	,SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
	,SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.BusinessUnit AS BusinessUnit
	,SRC.PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
	,SRC.PeriodEndDate AS PeriodEndDate
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'DID' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId 
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
	--,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	--,STUFF(PeriodEndDate,1,27,'20991231') AS PeriodEndDate
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT','UPDATE');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_WealthManagementGroupList_DELTA;

END
